blocks.text: You don’t have to wait until you have a tooth problem to seek dental care. In fact, preventative dental services can help you avoid unexpected visits! At Wyoming Family Dentistry, our dentist in Wyoming, OH, provides this kind of care to help patients maintain healthy teeth and gums.
What Is Preventative Dentistry?
This type of dentistry focuses on good oral health maintenance while decreasing the risk of tooth decay and other issues that may lead to serious complications.
What Are the Benefits of Preventive Dental Care?
Staying on top of your oral health with these services puts you in a good position to only need a couple of dental visits per year!
Other benefits include:

items: Reduced risk of tooth damage, such as fractures

blocks.text: What Preventive Dental Services Are There?
Preventative dentistry in Wyoming, OH, includes several types of care to lower your chance of developing oral health issues. Some of our services include the following.
Routine Cleanings
These cleanings remove all traces of tartar and plaque from your teeth, decreasing your risk of tooth decay and cavities. We also polish tooth surfaces for added shine!
Regular Exams
These checkups are a great opportunity for us to look for the earliest signs of cavities or other problems that we need to address now.
Dental Sealants
These coatings for your molars and premolars act as a protective barrier that keeps bacteria from building up or finding ways inside your teeth and causing decay.
Dental X-rays
We may need to take these images for a better look at what’s going on inside specific teeth or your jaw.
Fluoride Treatments
This mineral provides added protection from tooth decay while strengthening your tooth enamel!
How Often Do You Need Routine Dental Cleanings and Exams?
Our dentist would like to see you twice a year for these visits (or more often if needed).
